name: Build your tray lighting
summary: Build a complete ute tray lighting set in four steps: a pair of tail lights or a plug-and-play kit, a licence plate light, a trailer plug if you tow, and the brackets, patch leads or load resistors your lamps need. Out-of-stock items are shown with their status and never pre-selected.

steps.title: Pick your tail lights
steps.description: Choose a pair of combination tail lights or a plug-and-play kit. Every option here is sold as a pair or complete kit. Plug-and-play kits include vehicle-specific patch leads and licence plate lights.

steps.title: Add a licence plate light
steps.description: Skip this if your plug-and-play kit already includes licence plate lights. Some lamps need two fitted (the 41 Series fitting instructions require two), so check the product page.

steps.title: Plug and socket
steps.description: If you tow, add a plug that matches your trailer socket, or a flush Anderson socket for powering accessories.

steps.title: Brackets, patch leads and load resistors
steps.description: Add right-angle brackets, a vehicle patch lead or adaptor for hard-wired lamps, and load resistors if your vehicle shows a light-failure warning or fast flash. Only items compatible with your chosen lamps are shown.

name: Build your trailer lighting
summary: Light a box, boat or camper trailer in four steps: a pair of trailer tail lights, a licence plate light if your lamps don't include one, a plug to suit your tow vehicle with any cabling, and marker lights or load resistors where needed. Out-of-stock items are shown with their status and never pre-selected.

steps.title: Pick your trailer tail lights
steps.description: Choose a pair of trailer lamps. For boat trailers, pick lamps listed as submersible. Every option here is sold as a pair or pack of two.

steps.title: Add a licence plate light
steps.description: The 207 and 210 Series and the Narva pack already include a licence plate lamp. Otherwise add one here and check whether the lamp needs two fitted.

steps.title: Plug and cabling
steps.description: Choose a plug that matches your tow vehicle's socket, plus a plug-in cable kit for longer trailers.

steps.title: Marker lights and load resistors
steps.description: Larger trailers need side and end-outline markers. Add load resistors if your tow vehicle flashes fast or shows a bulb-failure warning with LED lamps.

seo.title: Build Your Trailer Lighting Kit | OzLED
seo.description: Build trailer or boat trailer lighting in four steps: LED tail lights, licence plate light, trailer plug and cable kit, plus marker lights and load resistors.
